name: Suzhou Good-Ark Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Good-Ark Electronics Co., Ltd., established in Suzhou, China, in 1990, operates as a global enterprise specializing in the conception, manufacturing, encapsulation, and distribution of individual semiconductor components. The company boasts a comprehensive product catalog featuring an array of diodes, including general-purpose, automotive rectifier, Zener, and Schottky varieties. Its rectifier offerings are equally extensive, covering fast recovery, super fast, high efficiency, Schottky barrier, power, high voltage, electronic lamp ballast, PFC boost, fast switching, and bridge rectifiers. Furthermore, Good-Ark supplies transient voltage suppressors, bi-directional trigger DIAC devices, and peak clamp devices. Dedicated to the solar energy sector, the firm also provides specialized bridge rectifiers, fast switching rectifiers, Schottky diodes, PESD products, MOSFETs, fuses, and bypass diode modules for solar cells. These crucial components are indispensable within power supply units across diverse industries, such as aerospace, automotive, eco-friendly lighting, information technology, household appliances, and heavy industrial equipment. Beyond its semiconductor production, the company actively engages in the research and development of silver paste for solar cells, various electronic pastes, and advanced sensors designed for networking applications.
